title: 5G: 2020 and Beyond
bookshelves: Category: Technology, Engineering, Agriculture, Industrial processes
summary: The future society would be ushered in a new communication era with the emergence of 5G. 5G would be significantly different, especially, in terms of architecture and operation in comparison with the previous communication generations (4G, 3G...). This book discusses the various aspects of the architecture, operation, possible challenges, and mechanisms to overcome them.
